objectives.text: Recognize which Java release a feature needs, such as lambdas (8), var (10), switch expressions (14) and records (16)
Rewrite an older idiom, such as an anonymous class or a colon switch, in its modern form
Inspect a short Java 8, 11 or 17 example, predict whether it compiles on JDK 25, and name the feature or migration issue behind the prediction

minutes.basis: Measured on the authored artifact.html with the frozen estimator (authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py): P50 8.88 minutes. Worst required path models one additional wrong graded attempt per interactive unit before it settles (1 predict, 1 explore, 1 mcq; predict 30 s, mcq 45 s, explore 20 s each, per the estimator cost table): 10.46 minutes. Budget and about label are ceil(max(P50, worst path)) = 11, under the 15-minute ceiling (authoring/docs/tools/validators.md, B8).

unverifiedItems: Author-checked against live official sources on 2026-10-16 (see authoring/evidence/java-foundations/testing-and-java-review/reading-older-java-code/sources.json); not yet verified by the independent Java/testing SME review.
Compatibility is not assumed: older source often, but not always, compiles on JDK 25; removed APIs, tools, options and dependencies can break it (intake reconciliation education-05, java-sme-002).
The practice JUnit runner imitates JUnit Jupiter 6.1.3 and Mockito 5.24.0 failure messages in shortened form; its output was not differential-tested against a real JUnit Platform run.
